findings.title: Identical start times share one window
findings.problem: Two sessions on one log with identical (or both missing, so 0) startTime get the same [from,to) window; the first in dedup order claims every record and the other gets $0.
findings.impact: Resumed sessions lacking startTime (legacy format) still show the original wrong attribution. Reachability of identical start times unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Tie-break by sessionId and give tied sessions disjoint windows.

findings.title: Solo session window drops pre-start records
findings.problem: buildWindows creates a window (from = startTime) for every own session, including ones alone on their log, so records with ts earlier than startTime are skipped.
findings.impact: Clock skew or inherited history silently lowers cost for non-resumed sessions. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Only build windows for files with more than one session (skip when list.length < 2).

findings.title: Filtered run omits sibling sessions
findings.problem: enrichCosts is called without extraSiblings, so when filters exclude the resumed (newer) session the older session's window extends to Infinity and claims the newer session's records.
findings.impact: Date/project-filtered analytics misattributes cost on resumed shared logs; session-report.ts already passes siblings.
findings.recommendation: Load unfiltered sessions and pass them as extraSiblings to enrichCosts.
